title: claude-settings mods update themselves after the first install
why: Your question, Oct 26: why did your claude-settings install never pick up the token-weather 500k fix? Mods were fetched once, on Oct 13, and never refreshed.
note: Checked at claude-settings main 3f71d6b (mods thread, Oct 26): the claude-settings marketplace entry in settings.json has no "autoUpdate": true, and Claude Code does not refresh third-party marketplaces by default; install.sh and install.ps1 never touch plugins, by design (decision mods-install-via-marketplace). So every mod stays at its first-install version (token-weather was at 0.1.0, now updated by hand to 0.1.2; desktop-statusline at 0.1.3 against main's 0.1.4; other mods not checked). Fix: PR #581 (mods auto-update from the claude-settings marketplace): one settings key, a pinning test, the decision and two debt notes rewritten. Proof after merge, on the Mac: after the first session, `claude plugin list` shows each claude-settings mod at main's version. Placed ahead of c52 (triage, Oct 26): the PR is built and waits only on a merge path (c53), and it carries #580 (c29) to the Mac with no manual update.
